channel.title: Dark Reading
channel.description: Trimmed fixture (2026-11-24): selected items, excerpts of at most 280 characters, names redacted, no author names.

item.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: CrowdStrike's $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler would unite endpoint protection and zero-trust network security to obtain greater control over AI agents.

item.title: AI Agents Zip From Flaw Discovery to Root Access in 11 Minutes
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: A China-nexus actor used the Cairn penetration testing tool in attacks against East Asian universities, exploiting a zero-day in a medical imaging app.

item.title: Microsoft Debuts Offensive, Defensive Security Tools for the AI Era
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: At its Ignite technical conference, Microsoft announced AI agent security tools and transparency standards to protect enterprise systems.

item.title: Navigating Vulnerability Hysteria in the AI Era
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: This installment of the Reporters' Notebook video series examines the fallout from recent high-severity flaw disclosures, exploring how fears of AI-assisted exploits trigger widespread panic, operational disruptions, and growing warning fatigue.

item.title: Strike Graph Launches Integration AI to Automate Continuous Compliance Evidence Using Any Existing Tool
item.description: New agentic AI solution leverages APIs to collect compliance evidence from systems and applies it to over 30 frameworks with no duplicate work.

item.title: Cursor Traces Malicious Claude Code Extensions to Third-Party Breach
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: A compromised key issued to AI infrastructure provider Fireworks was used by threat actors to access Cursor data and credentials.

item.title: Attackers in Binance Breach Targeted Known Weakness, Missing Controls
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: Blockchain complexities, such as attacker-deployed sweepers, hobble security controls designed to limit the damage of an exchange compromise.

item.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading staff
item.description: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files with credentials and other sensitive data to public Git repositories, creating security gaps for organizations.
